column9: E2E Journey 28: Cash ISA - Transfer IN - Return Deposit Rejected
column17:
1.  Create a Cash ISA account
2.  Create a Transfer Authority using Transfer IN - Add the following
    details - - Transfer Type = Transfer IN - ISA Type = Cash ISA -
    Channel = App/Web/Telephone/Post - ISA Provider Name = \[Ex: Bank
    Name\] - Current Year Subscription \[Select the checkbox \] -
    Subscribed in the current tax year, Transfer current year
    subscription - Current Year subscription amount = Enter the amount
    to be transferred - Transfer Effective From = ‘As soon as possible’
    - Transfer Effective Date = Today’s date - Declaration Signed -
    Select the checkbox - Click on the ‘Save’ button
3.  Fund the account using a ‘Non-Linked’ account
4.  A case will be created
5.  Associate the existing ‘Transfer Authority’ to the case
6.  Change the case owner from ‘Saving Servicing Queue’ to current user.
7.  Check ‘Return Deposit’ checkbox
8.  Click on ‘Submit for Approval’ button
9.  Login with another with ‘Savings approval queue’ permission set
10. Reject the case
11. Login with the primary user and verify the case is rejected

successful creation of a case 3) Verify the \'TA - Transfer IN Return
